claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, diclofenac is unlikely to kill cells through COX inhibition; any modest, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a physicochemical/cytotoxic NSAID class effect rather than a specific oncogenic dependency.
